findings.detail: PIK-only private-credit coupons are present in the source coupon column but were left blank in extracted interest_rate.
22 HoldCo Limited senior subordinated loan has source coupon 12.16% PIK but the flagged extracted row has no interest_rate or basis_spread.
ADG second lien senior secured loan has source coupon 10.00% PIK but the flagged extracted row has no interest_rate or basis_spread.

rationale: X02 flags PRIVATE_CREDIT rows with no extracted interest_rate or basis_spread. The raw Ares Capital schedule includes explicit Coupon, Reference, and Spread columns. For flagged missing-rate examples, the source rows show populated coupon cells, including 14.00% PIK for 15484880 Canada senior subordinated loan, 12.16% PIK for 22 HoldCo Limited senior subordinated loan, and 10.00% PIK for ADG second lien senior secured loan. The blank extracted values therefore reflect a coupon extraction gap rather than a correct absence of source rate data.
